The verified regional standard requires 5 sqm net useful area per child in the room exclusively dedicated to children, with a minimum of 15 sqm net; this room area cannot be inferred from the dwelling’s gross area. Confirm the required domestic facilities and check planning compatibility, permits, hygiene, accessibility, safety, and the authorization procedure. Verify which regulatory requirements apply when submitting the application, given the stated transition to the 2025 rules.

cons: The data do not establish whether a dedicated children’s room meets the verified minimum of 15 sqm net useful area or the 5 sqm per child standard.

evaluation_results.evaluation_text: This 165 sqm residential dwelling is a promising candidate for a home-based nursery, with a recorded capacity for four people and a quiet residential setting consistent with the objective. Its energy class C meets the stated preference, and the green-space proximity score of 92.0 is particularly strong. The supplied data do not establish whether the dwelling has the required dedicated room, kitchen, bathroom, outdoor space, or authorization. The verified regional standard specifies at least 5 sqm of net useful area per child in an exclusively dedicated space, with a minimum of 15 sqm net useful area for that space; this is not a minimum for the whole property. Verify the applicable rules at the application date and check planning compatibility, building title and use, hygiene, accessibility, fire safety where required, structural safety, and sector authorization.
pros: Residential dwelling with 165 sqm of gross floor area and recorded capacity for four people, aligning with the stated property preferences.
Energy class C meets the user's preferred threshold; the total energy score is 14.
Green-space proximity score of 92.0 is high, with strong mobility (82.6) and commercial-service (85.5) proximity scores.
cons: The data do not confirm a dedicated child-care space of at least 15 sqm net useful area or the required net area per child; the gross property area alone cannot establish this.
Kitchen, bathroom, and outdoor-space conditions are not confirmed in the supplied property data.

Planning compatibility, building title and any change of use, hygiene, accessibility, applicable fire and structural safety requirements, and sector authorization require verification; the applicable regulatory transition also needs checking.
